cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Outside the Scope
cards.instruction: Redirect personal or dangerous questions by declaring them irrelevant, premature, or assigned to another process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've folded my menu like yours. Dinner session. Why I missed our anniversary belongs in the calendar review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's propping up the table leg. This is our replacement dinner. Explain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Table ready. This booking covers dinner, not the review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. I'll cancel dessert and we can talk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we need to resolve the cancellation before opening a second complaint.
